Sarah L.: Following up from the 2026-03-20 P99 latency postmortem. Need clear owners, Jira links, RACI, and handoffs. Please ack and update by EOD Fri.

Sarah L.: ```
- INFR-3421: KV cache eviction on long contexts -> Owner: Rajesh K. | Due: 2026-04-02 | R: Rajesh, A: Tom B., C: Megan C., I: Eng SRE
- PM-890: Canary config mismatch -> Owner: Olivia P. | Due: 2026-03-30 | R: Olivia, A: Sarah L., C: DevEx, I: All
- INFR-3456: Long-tail batching fallback -> Owner: Tom B. | Due: 2026-04-09 | R: Tom, A: Rajesh, C: ML Eng, I: Console Team
- PM-901: KV evictions epic (recurring pattern) -> Owner: Megan C. | Due: 2026-04-16 | R: Megan, A: Sarah L., C: SRE/ML, I: Product
```

Rajesh K.: Ack. I'll create INFR-3421 subtask for the evictor unit test and attach perf logs. ETA initial PR by 2026-03-29.

Tom B.: I can own INFR-3456. Q: include quantization work or spike first? Prefer spike-only to limit rollout risk.

Megan C.: We had similar KV evictions in Q4 (INFR-3000, INFR-3182). PM-901 should be an epic to capture RCA + mitigations. @Sarah L. can you make that an epic? :eyes:

Olivia P.: Canary ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-890 — adding acceptance criteria and runbook updates. Handoff to infra 2026-03-25.

Sarah L.: Yes Megan, create PM-901 'kv-evictions-epic' and assign me as A until prioritization set. Megan, draft SLO/regression proposals into the epic by 2026-04-02.

Tom B.: Spike ticket up: INFR-3460. PRs will reference it. cc @Rajesh K.

incidents-bot: Incident 2026-03-20-PL99 closed. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-20-p99-latency

Megan C.: I'll take PM-901 for RCA epic writeup. Scheduling sync with SRE/ML next Tue. Can someone add me to infra calendar & postmortem check rotation?

Sarah L.: Added calendar invite. Weekly check-in rotation: week of 2026-03-29 -> Rajesh K., week of 2026-04-05 -> Tom B. 30m standups to surface blockers.

Tom B.: Confirming standups. @DevEx please share dev container + repro steps.

DevEx: Will post dev container and quickrun doc by EOD tomorrow and attach to Jira tickets.

Megan C.: Opening epic now, will include timeline of past evictions and proposed regression harness.

Sarah L.: Final: owners, link Jira to the postmortem page and mark 'blocked-by' if infra capacity or access required. Mark postmortem status 'in-progress' after ticket creation.

Olivia P.: Acked. PM-890 updated with runbook and handoff notes.

Tom B.: If batching fallback is quick, we'll hotfix before epic. I'll surface in first standup.

Rajesh K.: Will attach perf counter dumps and mitigation proposal to INFR-3421 by 2026-03-29.

Megan C.: RCA sync invite sent for Tue 2026-03-23 10:30 PT.

Sarah L.: Thanks — we'll reconvene after the initial updates to decide if PM-901 needs elevated priority.
